commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Laszlo Boloni decides to make a substitution. Georges Mikautadze will be replaced by Sadibou Sane (Metz).
90+3' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score.
90+2' The ball goes out of play. Clermont are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Clermont can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The free kick from long range, taken by Clermont, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Clermont.
89' Lamine Camara (Metz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Gael Angoula blows for a foul. Clermont will take a free kick near the side line.
89' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a change. Yohan Magnin (Clermont) replaces Habib Keita.
89' Pape Diallo (Metz) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
86' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kevin Van Den Kerkhof as he is replaced by Pape Diallo (Metz).
85' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' Clermont couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
79' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
78' Here is a change. Didier Lamkel Ze is going off and Laszlo Boloni gives the last tactical orders to Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremie Bela (Clermont) replaces Johan Gastien.
77' A corner kick by Clermont is thwarted by the well prepared Alexandre Oukidja (Metz).
76' The ball is cleared after Johan Gastien (Clermont) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Clermont.
75' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Metz will take a corner kick.
73' The rebound finds Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance!
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Clermont.
71' Alan Virginius (Clermont) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Clermont are going to take it.
69' The corner is swung in but Clermont can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Gael Angoula couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Habib Keita (Clermont) and blew his whistle.
63' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Alan Virginius (Clermont) coming on for Jim Allevinah.
61' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) replacing Shamar Nicholson.
61' That will be all from Elbasan Rashani who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
60' A yellow card for a tackle by Johan Gastien (Clermont). Gael Angoula doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

59' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja pulls off a brilliant save.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
54' Neto Borges (Clermont) sees a yellow card from Gael Angoula after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
49' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) was too forceful with his tackle and Gael Angoula interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
47' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Gael Angoula shows the yellow card to Chrislain Matsima (Clermont) for a heavy challenge.
43' Neto Borges (Clermont) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
39' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) for a tough tackle.
37' A rebound bounces out to Georges Mikautadze (Metz) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
37' The referee signals a corner kick to Metz.
35' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Georges Mikautadze (Metz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mory Diaw into middle of the goal.
31' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
31' Gael Angoula blows for a foul after Andy Pelmard (Clermont) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Metz!
30' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gael Angoula has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' Clermont take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Clermont will have a corner.

22' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Alexandre Oukidja makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom right corner.
22' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
18' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' 31:69 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
9' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
6' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) commits a rough challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
3' The linesman raises his flag. Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is adjudged offside.
2' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

The players are out at last! Metz will take the kick-off.
